plan.title: bug(hooks): dest-proven Grok implement spawn still hits #4007 on primary leftover actives; spawn cannot pass the story pin

narratives.Description: bug(hooks): dest-proven Grok implement spawn still hits #4007 on primary leftover actives; spawn cannot pass the story pin
narratives.Overview:
Spec is Bound remedy lean 5636715600, not the filed payload-pin-or-DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE body.

## Problem

A Grok Build **implement** parent that already has one dest-placed leaf cannot native-spawn the second (or later) leaf. Dest occupancy consult accepts `tool_input.cwd`. The deny is parent-root **active-scope** (#4007): two running briefs on primary `xbrief/active/`, no `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` pin.

`grok --cwd` last-resort then works because that process has dest as payload root (one copied brief). That is not the first-class Grok Build launch path (`host-grok-build.md`: CLI after a recorded native deny; do not dual-launch; do not document CLI as the real path).

## Why dest-root-swap is not this close

Closed #4215 locked v5: dest-proven implement spawn skips parent `verifySessionRitual`, then **parent-root active-scope stays**. Explicit drop: dest-root-swap of ritual/scope. Occupancy dest, dest-proven dest, persist dest-lock, and launch are `tool_input.cwd`. The fence that fired is the lock that remained.

## Field instance (2026-09-11, Grok Build, directive through-merge)

Parent: `session:start --read-only` on `C:\Repos\deft\directive`. Occupancy mutation claim on primary refused (dest-place).

1. #4361 dest-placed via native `spawn_subagent` `cwd=.deft-scratch/worktrees/4361-recut-vocab`. One eligible brief. Spawn admitted.
2. Operator added #4356. Parent promoted/activated on primary, copied the brief into a new dest worktree (`xbrief/active/` on dest had only that file).
3. Native `spawn_subagent` `cwd=<4356 dest>` denied:

```
Directive denied spawn_subagent: Multiple active xBRIEF artifacts are eligible
(2026-09-11-4356-..., 2026-09-11-4361-...).
The write fence cannot bind the first-sorted story...
Set DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE to the dispatched story path, or keep one running brief in xbrief/active/.
```

4. Dest consult did not reroot that fence. Eligible names were **primary** leftovers. Dest being single-brief was irrelevant.
5. Parent cannot set `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` on the Grok hook environ from a later shell. `spawn_subagent` schema is prompt/description/subagent_type/background/isolation/resume_from/cwd/model. Extra dest keys occupancy-deny. Prompt text is not a pin (`inspectActiveScope` reads env / boundPath only).
6. Recorded native deny. Last-resort `grok --cwd <dest> --prompt-file` admitted (dest payload root). Same for #4389 and #4390.

`admitEffectiveHookRoot` with `writeTarget === null` (spawn) keeps payloadRoot. Dispatcher then `inspectActiveScope(effectiveRoot)` on primary. Dest-proven skip is ritual only (#4215).

## Expected

Native dest-proven Grok **implement** spawn of leaf N (N>=2) succeeds while primary still holds N running briefs for the cohort ledger.

Keep #4215 parent-root active-scope. Do not dest-root-swap scope as the default of this issue.

Give the parent a host-visible way to bind the #4007 pin on that spawn:

- Prefer a **non-dest** spawn-payload field (story path / issue id) that `inspectActiveScope` already accepts as boundPath. Not `worktree_path`. Not `isolation=worktree`. Grok dest stays `cwd` only.
- Or host-environ `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` that the Grok PreToolUse stdin actually carries for that spawn (today a child shell cannot set the parent hook environ).

Orchestrators that already know the dest xBRIEF path must be able to pass it without CLI fallback.

## Non-goals

- Do not dest-root-swap ritual/scope (reopen #4215 locked v5). File a recut of #4215 if that is the wanted product.
- Do not weaken #4007 for in-tree product writes (two workers on one checkout must not share one file_scope).
- Do not make `grok --cwd` the first-class Grok Build launch path (#4215 / host-grok-build.md).
- Do not dual-launch native + CLI.
- Do not fold into #4391 (critic/docs recovery on primary leftovers) or #4315 (`process_only` missing on the spawn schema / #2885 zero-brief). Cite them. This is implement-class cohort spawn + pin transport.
- Do not fold into #4285 (`verify:ac --soft-missing-xbrief` runs every active brief).
- Do not recover with `session:start --rearm` on primary.

## Acceptance

- Native `spawn_subagent` with `cwd` to a reserved linked worktree, while primary `xbrief/active/` has two preflight-eligible running briefs, admits when the spawn names the dest story (payload pin or hook-visible `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE`).
- Unpinned spawn with two eligible briefs on payloadRoot still fail-closes (#4007).
- Grok extra dest keys (`worktree_path`, `isolation=worktree` + cwd) still occupancy-deny.
- Child still ritualizes dest before product writes.
- A regression test covers two primary actives + dest-proven cwd + pin -> allow; same without pin -> deny.
- CHANGELOG.
- Does not retarget the contract Grok seat to CLI as default.

## Related

- #4007 — multiple eligible actives; pin or fail closed; no first-sorted bind
- #4215 — dest-proven skip is parent ritual only; parent-root active-scope stays (closed, locked v5)
- #4066 — dest required; Grok cannot rewrite spawn input; dest is cwd
- #4391 — same Deny 1 for **critic** spawn from primary; docs/playbook recovery; not this implement pin
- #4315 — Grok schema cannot pass `process_only`
- #4285 — check/AC walks every active brief; opposite polarity, same multi-active tree
- `packages/core/src/hooks/scope.ts` `inspectActiveScope` / `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE`
- `packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts` spawn then parent-root scope
- `content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/references/host-grok-build.md` CLI last-resort

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-11T15:23:36Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Open critique of #4393 (implement-class Grok cohort spawn + #4007 pin transport). Pin SHA 7e7d07d80fc4af26442232ddac96a7543b0f11aa. Input ceiling 5636607808. Not #4391 and not #4315.

## 1. Per-spawn pin has no host-visible channel — blocks-the-design

Evidence. Re-verified at the pin, not from line cites:

- This Grok Build `spawn_subagent` schema forwards `prompt`, `description`, `subagent_type`, `background`, `isolation`, `resume_from`, `cwd`, `model`. Same closed list as Stop 1 comment 5636607808.
- `packages/cli/src/hook-dispatch.ts` `run()` calls `decideHook` with host, event, projectRoot, payload, payloadContext only. Stdin is not an environ bag.
- `inspectMutationGates` then does `input.environ ?? process.env` and `inspectActiveScope(effectiveRoot, { env: environ })`. Spawn admission hardcodes `effectiveRoot = payloadRoot` (it does not call `admitEffectiveHookRoot`; `writeTarget === null` would have returned the same root).
- `spawnUpdatedInput` returns undefined when `appliesGrokSpawnDestContract` is true. The hook cannot inject a pin (#4066).
- Occupancy consult occupancy-denies Grok extra dest keys (`worktree_path` / `worktreePath` / `worktree`) and `isolation=worktree` together with `cwd`. A non-dest key would pass that consult. The host still does not forward one.

Failure mode. `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` in a later child shell does not change the PreToolUse hook process. Setting it on the parent Grok process is one pin for every concurrent `spawn_subagent`. Cohort leaf N>=2 races or binds the same leftover. A new `tool_input` field this host does not forward never reaches `pinFrom`. Native dest-proven implement spawn of leaf N>=2 still gets `formatMultipleActiveMessage` on primary leftovers.

Disposition. The lean cannot bind "payload pin or hook-visible `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE`" as equivalent closes. Bind one per-spawn channel this host actually forwards (schema field into `boundPath`, or a stdin env bag that `hook-dispatch` threads). Treat process-wide `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` as not cohort-safe. Cite #4315 only as the same closed-schema fact; do not recut this issue into `process_only`.

## 2. Pin grammar is path or unique basename, not issue id — sharpens-framing

Evidence. `matchPinnedActiveScope` accepts an absolute path, a project-relative path, or a unique basename. Basename fallback runs only when the pin has no `/`. `scope.test.ts` binds relative `xbrief/active/b-story.xbrief.json`, unique basename `b-story.xbrief.json`, and `boundPath`. A path-shaped miss (`xbrief/pending/...`) does not degrade to basename. Token `"4356"` is not the basename of `2026-09-11-4356-….xbrief.json`. A dest-absolute xBRIEF path is path-shaped; `containedResolved` from primary returns null (`..`); the pin miss-closes.

Failure mode. Preferred "story path / issue id" and acceptance "names the dest story" admit pins `inspectActiveScope` already rejects. The spawn then still fail-closes with `formatMissingPinMessage`.

Disposition. The lean can bind if the pin grammar is the existing matcher against payloadRoot: `xbrief/active/<file>` or unique basename. Drop issue id. "Dest story" means that primary-ledger name, not dest's absolute path.

## 3. Spawn never passes boundPath — sharpens-framing

Evidence. The only `inspectActiveScope` call in `dispatcher.ts` is `{ env: environ }`. `boundPath` already wins over env in `pinFrom` and is covered for writes in `scope.test.ts`. Spawn dest tests stub `inspectScope` to ready or to a zero-brief message. There is no live fixture of two primary eligible actives + dest-proven `cwd` + pin.

Failure mode. A host-visible field that never becomes `boundPath` leaves #4007 in place. Env-only wiring also cannot distinguish concurrent cohort spawns (finding 1).

Disposition. The lean can bind if the spawn branch passes `boundPath` from the host-visible field and keeps env as the CLI fallback. The issue's regression (two primary actives + dest-proven `cwd` + pin allow; same without pin deny) is the right control.

## Injection / swarm

Trigger: authority, untrusted spawn input, envelopes, concurrency, worktrees, shared state.

- Prompt and description must not become pins. Extra dest keys stay occupancy-deny. Grok dest stays `cwd` only.
- Primary leftover actives are shared cohort ledger. Dest-lock already unique-fences dests (`existingDispatchReservation` / leftover-release then mint). Process-wide `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` is a second shared cell across concurrent spawns from one hook process.
- Spawn pin selects which primary leftover admits the launch. Child product writes still gate on dest after write-target admission. A pin that matches any eligible leftover admits even if dest was prepared for another story. Unpinned multi-active on payloadRoot must still fail closed.
- `destProven` skips parent ritual only. `inspectScope` stays on payloadRoot. Do not skip #2885 on destProven (locked: dest-proven implement-class with no active still `spawn-not-ready`).
- CLI `grok --cwd` last-resort after a recorded native deny stays last-resort (`host-grok-build.md`). Do not retarget the Grok seat to CLI.

## Road-not-taken

Dest-root-swap of `inspectActiveScope` when `destProven`, keeping parent-root for in-tree writes and keeping dest occupancy. Steelman: spawn has no write target; dest-lock unique-fences; the field instance dest held one copied brief. Flip: dest can hold two eligible briefs, or dest is empty. This issue forbids dest-root-swap as the default (#4215 locked v5). Choosing pin-transport therefore inherits finding 1's host channel.

## 4. Spawn inlines payloadRoot admission — footnote

`admitEffectiveHookRoot(writeTarget === null)` returns payloadRoot. Spawn does not call it; it inlines `{ root: payloadRoot, … }`. Same effect. Not a second close.
